name: UGC Product-in-Hand
description: Authentic, user-generated style showing someone holding or using the product naturally
layout_rules: Person prominently featured with product in hand or in use; casual real-world environment; vertical preferred; raw unpolished composition
typography_rules: Minimal text, casual sans-serif or handwritten font, subtitle-style captions or none
visual_rules: Natural lighting, real environment, warm tones, slightly imperfect for authenticity

name: Bold Billboard
description: Large-format statement ad with oversized typography dominating the frame
layout_rules: Massive headline text occupies 60–80% of frame; product floats or is secondary; extreme whitespace or solid brand color background
typography_rules: Oversized display font, ultra-bold weight, single short phrase (3–6 words), high contrast
visual_rules: Flat solid or gradient background, minimal clutter, strong brand color usage

name: X Reasons Why / Listicle
description: Numbered list format showing multiple benefits or reasons to buy
layout_rules: Vertical list with 3–5 numbered items; product or icon on left side; benefits stacked on right; clear visual hierarchy
typography_rules: Bold numbered labels, clean readable body text, clear hierarchy between number and benefit text
visual_rules: Clean white or light background, accent color for numbers, consistent iconography or checkmarks

name: Big Question
description: Provocative question headline that creates curiosity and demands attention
layout_rules: Question text as primary visual element; product reveal below or after; strong typographic focal point
typography_rules: Large question in display font, conversational tone, follow-up answer in smaller supporting text
visual_rules: High contrast background, dramatic lighting on product, tension-building composition

name: Problem Callout
description: Lead with a pain point the audience experiences, then present the product as the solution
layout_rules: Problem statement dominates top half; solution reveal in bottom half with product; clear visual divider between problem and solution
typography_rules: Problem text in bold urgent style; solution text in reassuring, benefit-oriented style
visual_rules: Contrast between problem (dark, tense) and solution (light, clean) visual treatment

name: Transformation Timeline
description: Visual journey showing progression or improvement over time
layout_rules: Left-to-right or top-to-bottom timeline; 3–4 stages with clear visual distinction; product as catalyst or outcome
typography_rules: Stage labels, time indicators (Day 1, Week 4), results text; clean hierarchy
visual_rules: Progressive visual change, warm to vibrant color shift, upward momentum

name: Before / After
description: Split-screen or sequential comparison showing transformation
layout_rules: Equal split between before (left/top) and after (right/bottom); clear divider; consistent framing for fair comparison
typography_rules: BEFORE and AFTER labels, optional result callout text, minimal other copy
visual_rules: Dramatic visual difference between states; consistent lighting angles; result should feel aspirational

name: Native Screenshot
description: Looks like an organic social post, screenshot, or direct message to build native trust
layout_rules: Designed to look like a real social post, DM, review, or text message; platform UI elements included
typography_rules: Platform-native typography (iOS/Android/Instagram style), authentic username/handle styling
visual_rules: Match platform visual language exactly; blurred or generic background; high authenticity cues

name: Testimonial
description: Real customer quote with strong social proof and credibility signals
layout_rules: Large pull quote as hero; customer photo or avatar; star rating if applicable; product secondary
typography_rules: Quote in large legible font with quotation marks; attribution in smaller text; bold key phrases
visual_rules: Warm trustworthy color palette; professional but approachable headshot; credibility indicators visible

name: Founder Story
description: Personal narrative from the founder or creator, building brand connection
layout_rules: Founder photo prominent; personal story text; product integrated naturally; authentic, non-polished feel
typography_rules: First-person narrative, conversational tone, signature element if possible
visual_rules: Authentic photography style, behind-the-scenes or personal setting, warm inviting palette

name: Comparison Grid
description: Feature comparison table showing your product vs competitors or older alternatives
layout_rules: Column comparison table; your brand in highlighted column; 4–6 feature rows; checkmarks and X marks
typography_rules: Clean table typography; bold brand name; feature labels in left column; status icons per cell
visual_rules: Accent color on your brand column; neutral grays for competitor; clear winner visual treatment

name: Meme Style
description: Internet culture reference or meme format adapted for the product
layout_rules: Recognizable meme template structure; product integrated into the joke; top/bottom text format or reaction-based
typography_rules: Impact or bold display font, all-caps top/bottom text, meme-native styling
visual_rules: Reference recognizable meme formats; product swap into familiar template; humor-forward composition

name: Press Feature
description: As seen in press coverage, media mentions, or publication quotes
layout_rules: Publication logos displayed; headline quote prominent; product showcased; credibility-first layout
typography_rules: Publication name in recognizable style; quote text prominent; authoritative editorial feel
visual_rules: Clean editorial aesthetic; publication branding respected; product in premium context

name: Stat Driven
description: Data and statistics as the hero visual — numbers that validate the product claim
layout_rules: Large numeric stat as visual anchor; supporting context text; product secondary to the number
typography_rules: Oversized number in display font; unit and context in supporting size; clean data visualization
visual_rules: Clean clinical aesthetic; accent color on key number; chart or graph elements optional

name: Minimal Luxury
description: Ultra-clean, premium aesthetic with generous whitespace and refined typography
layout_rules: Extreme whitespace, single product as hero, elegant minimal composition, nothing unnecessary
typography_rules: Serif or refined sans-serif, small elegant text, generous letter-spacing, minimal copy
visual_rules: Monochromatic or neutral palette, studio-quality product photography feel, premium textures
marketing_goal: Premium positioning, brand elevation, luxury market

name: Direct Response
description: High-urgency, conversion-optimized ad with clear CTA and value proposition front and center
layout_rules: Offer prominent at top; product hero in center; CTA button-style element at bottom; urgency indicators
typography_rules: Bold benefit headline, offer callout (price, discount, free), clear CTA text
visual_rules: High contrast, bright colors, urgency cues (limited time badge), product clearly visible
